# Zetesis

> Sovereign research substrate for free-first provider routing, bounded static acquisition, budget enforcement, citations, deep inquiry, steelmanning, and briefings.

Zetesis is pre-release. The implementation shape is four crates: `zetesis`, `sylloge`, `elenkhos`, and `synopsis`. Most behavior is planned; the contract baseline separates what has landed from what has not.

## Surface

The landed Rust surface is the `sylloge` provider, constraint, network-target, citation, result, cost, budget, and deep-research lifecycle types, re-exported by the `zetesis` facade. No provider adapter, HTTP client, cache, durable ledger, model binding, or daemon exists yet. Planned: bounded static acquisition with a versioned evidence envelope (zetesis#48), a durable identity-bound paid-spend ledger (zetesis#47), and deep inquiry through a consumer-granted model contract.

## Architecture

- [docs/design/contract-baseline.md](docs/design/contract-baseline.md): public API inventory, contract ownership, identity and idempotency, evidence envelope v1, storage

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): landed and planned crate roles
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): phase, recent changes, and open threads
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted design decisions
- [_llm/glossary.toml](_llm/glossary.toml): zetesis vocabulary

## Agent Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): purpose and public boundaries
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): repo conventions and design principles

- [Cargo.toml](Cargo.toml): manifest for the four-crate workspace (`zetesis`, `sylloge`, `elenkhos`, `synopsis`); `sylloge` carries the landed implementation, `elenkhos`/`synopsis` are reserved crate boundaries
